description: Full-text search over abstracts and full texts, with extracted technical specifications (values, ranges, tolerances, units). Numeric constraints like "50 Nm" are matched. Paid ($0.001, x402).

category.description: Result category: tech_specs (specification tables) or general

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return

query.description: Words and optional numeric constraints, e.g. 'torque sensor 50 Nm'

topic.description: Topic slug from list_topics, e.g. laser-calibration

name: search_specs
title: Search technical specifications
